entities.summary: Bademus was a prominent entrepreneur of the Classical era, active in Persia (modern-day Iran), who played a significant role in shaping the religious landscape of the region. He was known for his business acumen and his ability to navigate the complex web of religious figures and empires of the time. Bademus's legacy can be seen in the many religious institutions and communities that he influenced, and his impact on the region's religious identity continues to be felt today. Notably, he was one of the earliest recorded figures to adopt the title of 'Sufi,' a label that would come to define a major branch of Islamic mysticism. Despite the passing of centuries, Bademus's impact on the region's spiritual and cultural landscape remains an important chapter in the history of Sufism.
